about_blocks.text: Many people who struggle with alcohol or drug addiction don’t have the luxury of being able to take time off work or to leave their home lives to seek full-time, residential treatment. People with addictions will sometimes shy away from professional treatment simply because they cannot make a full-time commitment or find the financial barriers to be too great. At Cedars, we understand this dilemma and have created an outpatient program alternative for those seeking reprieve from addiction in the region of Victoria, BC. In certain cases, individual counseling or long-term intensive residential rehab programs are simply not the best option for the patient. Cedars Victoria is designed specifically to accommodate work, life and recovery in a harmonious environment for those who need an alternative to inpatient care. Our clinical team has designed and optimized an innovative Intensive Outpatient Program (IOP) for people who require intensive treatment but want an alternative to a long-term residential rehab programs. At Cedars Victoria, we believe everyone deserves a chance at a new life. Addiction is a very treatable disease and with our specialized programs we believe we can help anyone suffering from addiction to find recovery.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
